verdict: ROAS is healthy this period, but revenue is coming in bursts, not steadily.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $3.54 for every $1.00 spent — a strong headline number, driven by 22 purchases and $5,311.58 in revenue. However, those purchases are clustered into roughly 6 days; 16 of the 28 days recorded zero purchases, meaning revenue is arriving in short bursts rather than as a reliable daily flow. The subscription box campaign is carrying the majority of that load at 57% of total spend, so we're actively working to diversify the creative mix before that campaign fatigues. Expect continued focus on broadening the ad structure and getting the video content pipeline moving to build more consistent day-to-day momentum heading into September.
